notes.title: HOTFIX AND TWEAKS
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

Let me start off by saying a massive thank you to everyone who has already purchased the game.
Going on some recent feedback I have created a small Hotfix to fix some minor issues with the game as listed below.

[h1] FIXES AND TWEAKS[/h1]

* Fixed rare issue with one of the deer blocking you in the house. ( I killed it. ːsteamhappyː )

* Changed up interact key to make it more intuitive. This is now the 'E' key 

* One diary page was sunken underneath the map making it impossible to collect. 
(This has now been rectified)

* Optimised the lighting for Improved performance on older hardware.

* Added objective tool tip on game start so players know where to go from the start. 



As always Feedback in very important to us. Please report any bugs or issues you may have in the discussions tab. these will be fixed and corrected as soon as possible. 

Thank you 

Michael Schade - Developer
